name: requete-sql
description: Requête — Apprends le SQL (web + app iOS via Capacitor)

scripts.ios:add: npm run build:www && npx cap add ios && bash scripts/ios-ecran-lancement.sh && node scripts/ios-widget.mjs
scripts.ios: npm run build:www && npx cap sync ios && bash scripts/ios-ecran-lancement.sh && node scripts/ios-widget.mjs && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:testflight: npm run build:www && npx cap sync ios && bash scripts/ios-ecran-lancement.sh && node scripts/ios-widget.mjs && bash scripts/ios-testflight.sh
scripts.ios:verif: npm run build:www && npx cap sync ios && bash scripts/ios-ecran-lancement.sh && node scripts/ios-widget.mjs && bash scripts/ios-verif.sh
